outcome: severity of neonatal jaundice (requiring phototherapy or exchange transfusion)
cohort: The cohort consisted of neonates (aged <=28 days) admitted to Ibn Al-Balady Hospital in Baghdad, Iraq, including those with severe neonatal jaundice (cases) and those without severe jaundice (controls).
finding: Low birth weight was significantly associated with increased odds of severe neonatal jaundice, while no significant association was found between macrosomia and severe NNJ.
birth_weight: categorized as <2500 g (low), 2500-3999 g (normal), and >=4000 g (macrosomia)
gest_age: measured and adjusted for, with preterm birth identified as a major risk factor
